{{Quote|Let's get these beasts up the ramp! Hurry, the fleet departs for the rendezvous in one standard hour.|A Sith soldier on the jungle world|<ref name="TotJ" />}}
A [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] '''world''' had rainforests on its surface, featuring gnarled [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and long [[Grass/Legends|grass]]. The [[Planet/Legends|world]] was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TotJ" /> During the reign of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] of the Empire transported [[Sith war behemoth]]s&mdash;a species of large, [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]] [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]] native to the<ref name="behemoth">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010809d_behemoth&c=rpg|series=Creature Feature|text=Sith War Behemoth}}</ref> [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Khar Delba]]&mdash;to several harsh jungle worlds,<ref name="behemoth" /> including the world with the gnarled trees,<ref name="TotJ" /> where the creatures were subjected to [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-long [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] programs in order to turn them into violent war beasts for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Army/Legends|armies]].<ref name="behemoth" />

At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] preparations to [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|attack]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TotJ" /> in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> his [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] maneuvered several of the war behemoths of the jungle world into the [[Sith drop ship|troop containers]] of a [[Sith dreadnaught|Sith personnel carrier]] waiting to take them to the [[Sith invasion fleet]].<ref name="TotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The jungle planet was introduced in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|second issue]] of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire|''The Fall of the Sith Empire'']] story arc of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series.<ref name="TotJ" /> The issue was published on [[July 23]], [[1997]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54583/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_fall_of_the_sith_empire_1997_2|text=Star Wars: Tales of The Jedi - The Fall of the Sith Empire (1997) #2}}</ref> written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], and penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]]<ref name="TotJ" />
